extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.13.0 - For Arctic Zephyr Stremio's new look: info page text (Play / Resume S1 E3, facts, age rating and rating, episode ratings); the info page header follows the focused episode; season and episode context menus are a single watched toggle; picking an episode plays or opens streams per the autoplay setting; full release dates on catalog items; catalogs open in the skin's new Stremio view. Next Page on a home widget or hub row reloads the row in place on the next page (with Previous Page), focused on its first title; hub rows get Filter by Genre, also in place. Selecting a show opens its info page when selecting opens info. A saved view the skin no longer has falls back to the default. New "Back stops playback" setting (on). Playing again straight after a Stop no longer fails: a stream that fails to open is tried once more before the next one. v0.12.1 - New Kodi Stremio Bridge logo for the icon and fanart. v0.12.0 - One info page for movies, shows, seasons and episodes; search as you type for Arctic Zephyr Stremio; watched banners for shows and seasons.
